entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. This is completely unacceptable. I bought a pair of your so-called 'performance' cycling shoes, and they are complete and utter garbage. I want my money back, now!

I can certainly look into that for you, and I understand your frustration. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

A fault? They're defective! I spent an hour trying to get the cleats adjusted right, took them for one single ride, and they gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. I can barely walk! This is ridiculous. I'm telling you, if I don't get a full refund I'm blasting you all over every cycling forum and social media platform I can find. Get me your manager!

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes caused you blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. There's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you directly. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name or order number?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number 778-12B-99C. Just process the return.

Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes, delivered 35 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve a full refund for you.
Oh. So... you're just going to do it? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label for you right now, and it should be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Okay. Well... good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
